description: A minimal AI agent built from scratch — no agent framework, just Python, the OpenAI SDK, and a `while` loop. Accompanies the Medium article "Build Your Own AI Agent from Scratch." Three execution modes: `local` (Ollama only), `remote` (cloud provider), `mixed` (local orchestrates, delegates to remote).
